iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear risk remains imminent: AP reports the IAEA still lacks access to facilities hit in the June war and cannot verify suspended enrichment activity or stockpile location; Reuters reported limited new damage to the program and US/Israeli demands still block a nuclear settlement.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Iran conventional risk remains imminent: Reuters continues to frame Hormuz control as the main trigger for the next clash; prior US retaliatory strikes and unresolved Gulf energy pressure keep military buildup and rejected diplomatic terms live.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon eased but stays critical: Reuters says Israel and Lebanon extended the ceasefire by 45 days after Washington talks, while recent Israeli strikes in Lebanon and security-zone deployments keep violation and force-posture risk active.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Turkey remains deterrent: fresh search surfaced mediation warnings and regional commentary, not a new cross-border surge or official atomic warning from Ankara.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains deterrent: fresh results were stale or retrospective and did not show a new Kashmir crisis, border surge, or command alert.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk remains critical: Reuters reported Zelenskiy warning Russia is considering an operation from Belarus toward northern Ukraine or a NATO country; Bulletin coverage of the Sarmat test keeps strategic signaling in frame without evidence of immediate NATO contact.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains elevated: Reuters coverage shows Beijing defending regular activity around Taiwan, but the fresh scan did not surface a new blockade drill or crisis-level PLA posture change.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea remains deterrent: April ballistic activity stays on the watch list, but the fresh scan found no new weapons event, device event, or official atomic escalation in the current window.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains imminent: fresh reporting describes overnight Russian attacks wounding more than 30 and a bloody week after a brief pause; diplomacy exists, but battlefield pressure and strike tempo dominate.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains elevated but falling: DW reports useful China-hosted talks after February clashes; residual border force posture persists, but no fresh heavy clash surfaced in this scan.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains elevated/high-end: drone warfare, RSF/Sudan army deployments, external backing concerns and infrastructure pressure continue, but the fresh scan did not meet a new-tracker or imminent-spillover threshold.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Israel-Palestine risk rising: Israel killed Hamas Gaza armed chief Izz al-Din al-Haddad and continued Gaza strikes while indirect talks over the post-war plan remain deadlocked; retaliatory risk increased though Hamas did not issue an explicit revenge threat.

latest_news.headline: IAEA still lacks Iran nuclear access
latest_news.text: AP reports the IAEA cannot verify enrichment activity or enriched-uranium stockpile status because Iran has not given access to facilities hit in the June war.

latest_news.headline: Reuters flags Hormuz as next Iran clash trigger
latest_news.text: Reuters commentary says renewed Tehran-Washington confrontation would become more likely as sides test control of energy flow through the Strait of Hormuz.

latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire extended 45 days
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend the ceasefire after Washington talks, with follow-up meetings planned despite recent hostilities.

latest_news.headline: Israeli strikes killed 12 in Lebanon
latest_news.text: Reuters reported a series of Israeli strikes on cars in Lebanon ahead of US-mediated talks, keeping ceasefire-violation risk active.

latest_news.headline: Zelenskiy warns of Russia-Belarus NATO option
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Zelenskiy saying Russia is considering an operation from Belarus either toward northern Ukraine or against a NATO country.

latest_news.headline: Russia highlights Sarmat strategic missile test
latest_news.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists notes Russia announced a Sarmat ICBM test on May 12, reinforcing strategic signaling even as modernization remains uneven.

latest_news.headline: Russian overnight attacks wound more than 30
latest_news.text: Aawsat reported Russia launched hundreds of drones and nearly two dozen missiles overnight, wounding more than 30 people in Ukraine.

latest_news.headline: Bloody week follows brief Ukraine pause
latest_news.text: Washington Post reporting describes a bloody week after a brief ceasefire, including a deadly Kyiv strike and Ukrainian strikes on Russian residential buildings.

latest_news.headline: Afghanistan-Pakistan talks called useful
latest_news.text: DW reports China-hosted Afghanistan-Pakistan talks made useful progress after February cross-border fighting, lowering near-term escalation pressure.

latest_news.headline: DPRK missile activity remains stale watch item
latest_news.text: Reuters/AP-aligned April reporting showed short-range ballistic activity, but the fresh scan found no new current-window weapons event.
